description:
Outcome: An already-open board reflects queue changes without manual reload, from BRIEF.md and the owner's request to split automatic refresh from the page.
Scope: Refresh mechanism integrated into the board, stale/offline indication, reconnect recovery, response ordering and background-task cleanup. Excludes: SMS and an invented refresh SLA.
Acceptance: Added, claimed and finished visitors update automatically; loss of connectivity is signaled; reconnect loads current state; an older response never overwrites newer state; navigation does not leave duplicate background tasks.
Behaviour: Preserve last known board with a stale indicator on failure; recover without resetting the queue.
Verification: Controlled fixture changes, delayed/out-of-order responses, disconnect/reconnect and cleanup tests. Integrated staff actions are verified in T-011. Prerequisites: T-009 only; fixtures permit independent progress from T-005/T-006/T-007. Assumptions: choose the refresh mechanism during implementation; no provider is preselected.
title: Automatically refresh the board
